## User or Host result

Describe the task this change enables or repairs. Link the issue if there is one.

## Changes

Summarize the implementation and any compatibility impact.

## Verification

List the exact commands, environment, results and checks not run. A passing subset is not a full-suite or native-window acceptance result.

## Scope and recovery

For file/state changes: describe path boundaries, stale-state refusal, replay and recovery. For UI changes: include a screenshot with fictional or redacted content.

- [ ] No private documents, credentials, local state, or machine-specific evidence included.
- [ ] Existing third-party notices and attribution preserved.
